data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER topik_attempt_completed_immutable
BEFORE UPDATE OF id, test_id, level, section, round, mode, status, started_at,
  completed_at, updated_at, total_time_ms, current_question_no, question_count,
  max_score, score, correct_count, answered_count, content_version
ON topik_attempt
WHEN OLD.status = 'completed'
BEGIN

END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topik_attempt" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "test_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (level IN ('topik1', 'topik2')), "section" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (section IN ('listening', 'reading')), "round" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (round > 0), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('practice')), "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed')), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (total_time_ms >= 0), "current_question_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "question_count" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (question_count > 0), "max_score" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (max_score > 0), "score" INTEGER, "correct_count" INTEGER, "answered_count" INTEGER, "content_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (content_version > 0), "server_version" INTEGER, CHECK((status = 'completed')=(completed_at IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((status = 'completed')=(score IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((status = 'completed')=(correct_count IS NOT NULL)), CHECK((status = 'completed')=(answered_count IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(score BETWEEN 0 AND max_score), CHECK(answered_count BETWEEN 0 AND question_count), CHECK(correct_count BETWEEN 0 AND answered_count), CHECK(status = 'completed' OR server_version IS NULL));
CREATE INDEX idx_topik_attempt_test_started ON topik_attempt (test_id, started_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_topik_attempt_one_open ON topik_attempt (test_id) WHERE status = 'in_progress'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topik_attempt_answer" ("attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES topik_attempt(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "question_no" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (question_no > 0), "selected_idx" INTEGER CHECK (selected_idx BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "time_spent_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (time_spent_ms >= 0), "answered_at" INTEGER, "correct_idx" INTEGER CHECK (correct_idx BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "points" INTEGER CHECK (points > 0), "points_earned" INTEGER, "question_type" TEXT, CHECK((selected_idx IS NULL)=(answered_at IS NULL)), CHECK((correct_idx IS NULL)=(points IS NULL)), CHECK((correct_idx IS NULL)=(points_earned IS NULL)), CHECK((correct_idx IS NULL)=(question_type IS NULL)), CHECK(points_earned = CASE WHEN selected_idx = correct_idx THEN points ELSE 0 END), PRIMARY KEY(attempt_id, question_no));

CREATE TRIGGER topik_attempt_completed_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF id, test_id, level, section, round, mode, status, started_at, completed_at, updated_at, total_time_ms, current_question_no, question_count, max_score, score, correct_count, answered_count, content_version ON topik_attempt WHEN OLD.status = 'completed' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'topik_attempt is immutable once completed');END

CREATE TRIGGER topik_attempt_answer_completed_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON topik_attempt_answer WHEN (SELECT status FROM topik_attempt WHERE id = OLD.attempt_id) = 'completed' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'topik_attempt_answer is immutable once its attempt is completed');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT, "is_anonymous" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (is_anonymous IN (0, 1)), "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user', 'admin')), "validated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_transition" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), "op_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('switchAccount', 'signOut', 'delete', 'clearToAnon', 'anonRecovery')), "choice" TEXT CHECK (choice IN ('merge', 'discard')), "source_user_id" TEXT, "source_is_anonymous" INTEGER CHECK (source_is_anonymous IN (0, 1)), "target_user_id" TEXT, "target_hint" TEXT, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (stage IN ('started', 'sourcePushed', 'claimed', 'targetSignedIn', 'merged', 'localCleared', 'targetPulled', 'acknowledged', 'serverDeleted', 'signedOut', 'newAnon')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dismissed_note" ("note_key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "dismissed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("op_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (op IN ('upsert', 'delete')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "payload" TEXT, UNIQUE(entity_type, entity_id));
